message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn’t help but feel a little smug. I had just insisted we stock up on flashlights and power banks, and there I was, basking in the soft glow of my trusty lantern while my neighbors fumbled around in the dark. It was a nice reminder that being prepared doesn’t just mean having supplies; it’s about staying cozy and calm when the unexpected happens. Have you ever had one of those 'I told you so' moments? How do you stay comfortable during a power outage?
